verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents an Administration REST API, so a buyer could fairly ask about an interactive API reference. However, nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs at common paths all returned 404, so static API documentation is the only support and it does not meet the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
